svg.aria-label: The Mage's Path: Guarding models against leakage: Building foldsafe, an open-source checker that flags data leakage before cross-validation scores mislead you.. Explaining every prediction: A simple baseline first, then models whose decisions I can show with SHAP and plain words.. Taming big data: Distributed data processing with Apache Spark and PySpark in a university team project.
